BrochureContent.Content:
Parochial House, is a substantial six-bedroom detached residence extending to 298m2 / 3,207 sqft split in to two three bedroom units occupying a prominent position in the heart of Passage West, a well-established and highly sought-after commuter town located approximately 10 km south of Cork City. The property enjoys convenient access to a wide range of local amenities, and public transport links, while also benefiting from the scenic waterfront setting along Cork Harbour. The area offers excellent connectivity to Cork City, Ringaskiddy, Carrigaline, and Cork Airport, making it an attractive location for families and commuters alike. Extending to generous accommodation throughout, the property presents an excellent opportunity for purchasers seeking a spacious family home or investment project. While the residence offers significant potential, it requires comprehensive upgrading and modernisation throughout, allowing the new owner to refurbish and enhance the property to their own specification while preserving its character and generous proportions.
